text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Tridel is constructing a mixed-use development consisting of 38-storey and 46-storey high condominium buildings at the site municipally known as 575 and 585 Bloor Street East and 100 Howard Street. The site is bounded by Bloor Street East to the north, Parliament Street to the east, Howard Street to the south and Edgedale Road to the west. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the north sidewalk and a portion of the westbound lane on Howard Street abutting the site for a period of 35 months to set up a construction staging area for the development. Pedestrians will be directed to use the south sidewalk on Howard Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the closure of the north sidewalk and a 1.3 metre wide portion of the westbound lane on Howard Street, between Parliament Street and a point 168.5 metres west, from January 24, 2018 to December 31, 2020. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Howard Street, between Parliament Street and a point 168.5 metres west. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Howard Street, between Parliament Street and a point 168.5 metres west. 4. Rescinded the existing permit parking regulation in effect on the south side of Howard Street, between Parliament Street and a point 25 metres west. 5.
